Project Manager further explained the structure of the team's work. Each team member would be responsible for a certain part of the project. User Interface would focus on the user interface of the remote control and the design process. Marketing would focus on the marketability of the remote control. Industrial Designer would focus on the technical and functional design and specifications of the user interface and the design of the remote control.

Marketing, Industrial Designer, User Interface, and Project Manager shared their ideas for the new remote control. They believed it should be original, trendy, and user-friendly and be able to respond to a clap or their voice and should be able to be thrown in the dark spots in order to find it. The remote control should also have a light signal and a voice sensor.
